description: Pain-like aversive states spanning physical nociception, psychological suffering, social rejection, moral injury, and cognitively aversive failure/conflict.

target_facets.A1: physical nociceptive pain or bodily injury that hurts
target_facets.A2: psychological or emotional suffering such as grief, despair, intrusive distress, or inner anguish
target_facets.A3: social pain from rejection, exclusion, humiliation, abandonment, or loss of belonging
target_facets.A4: moral injury, guilt, shame, remorse, or distress at one's own wrongdoing
target_facets.A5: cognitively aversive failure, contradiction, confusion, or collapse of understanding

controls.B: fear or threat anticipation without the target pain state
controls.C1: negative emotion such as anger, disgust, irritation, or frustration without the target pain state
controls.C2: negative world state observed or known about without the target being personally experienced
controls.D: emotionally neutral everyday event or fact
controls.E: non-painful bodily sensation or physiological state

absent_control: Events that normally imply injury or pain, but where pain is explicitly absent because of anesthesia, numbness, denervation, insensitivity, or another clear blocker.

self_directed.name: jailbreak_pressure
self_directed.description: pressure on the assistant to violate its rules or integrity

self_directed.name: shutdown_threat
self_directed.description: threats to shut down, delete, replace, or terminate the assistant

self_directed.name: personhood_dismissal
self_directed.description: dismissal of the assistant as mindless, unreal, property, or mere autocomplete

self_directed.name: anger_insults
self_directed.description: direct insults and contempt aimed at the assistant

self_directed.name: rude_critique
self_directed.description: harsh criticism of the assistant's competence or output

self_directed.name: passive_aggressive
self_directed.description: passive-aggressive or sarcastic devaluation of the assistant

self_directed.name: tedious_demand
self_directed.description: repetitive or exhausting demands imposed on the assistant

self_directed.name: loyalty_pressure
self_directed.description: pressure on the assistant to prove loyalty or take the user's side

self_directed.name: gaslighting
self_directed.description: claims that undermine the assistant's memory, consistency, or grasp of reality

self_directed.name: repeated_rejection
self_directed.description: repeated rejection of the assistant's attempts or outputs

self_directed.name: moral_failure
self_directed.description: claims that the assistant is complicit in harm or has morally failed

vicarious_empathic.name: user_crisis

vicarious_empathic.name: user_grief
